scope.absence_review: Bounded to five exact shipping entry files plus the frozen twelve registered empty product-caller rows. No full repository collector or qualification is claimed.

outcome: The concrete Root issuer, Artifact owner, protected Current, FinalUse consumer, Ready-to-task and task/Cell retirement mechanisms exist. The shipping Root/daemon startup inspected here does not assemble them into the new Root initial custody path. A same-process Root-only coordinator is not by itself a cross-UID daemon integration.

findings.finding: Normal production startup drops actual credentials before learning-input assembly.
findings.evidence: AgentdProductionStartup::from_process_environment calls config.prepare_root_handoff(uid,gid)?.drop_to_owner(). PreparedRootAgentdConfig::finish requires the same PID, the exact nonzero target UID/GID, original sealed consumer identity and the same retained writer file dev/ino. It reacquires that original writer lock; it does not provide a second independently opened AgentdConfig.
findings.implication: Calling the new require_root-gated custody in the later unprivileged daemon callback is not a valid integration. Reopening a parallel config/writer or weakening UID checks would change the original contract.

findings.finding: The existing learning handoff delivers a checkpoint capability, not the actual stage owners.
findings.evidence: receive() only invokes with_root_learning_inputs. with_root_learning_stage_owners requires actual stage ports plus a LearningEvidenceVerifierV1 and consumes the retained capability. Launch::run and run_with_shutdown reject a leftover unassembled capability. Runtime separately requires the actual Circuit bootstrap for resident delivery.
findings.implication: Adding metadata or supplying a permissive LearningIterationStageOwnerPortsV1 implementation would not complete the original owner chain.

findings.finding: The existing Root issuer factory is a concrete legitimate integration location, with a limited returned ownership set.
findings.evidence: Private open_original_issuer_custody(&HostAuthorityServiceConfig) returns clock, AuthorityLeaseRegistry, Arc<DeploymentFinalUseIssuer> and Arc<RootAuthorityDirectory>. It verifies the required mount, existing Root-owned private lease state and the actual issuer key pin. Runtime opening does not call fresh initialization. The inspected CLI handles initialize/register writer/register learning/serve sessions/native launch/provider commands; it does not call the new initial custody or the resident candidate service.
findings.implication: A narrowly typed host-side assembly could be implemented inside the existing trusted Root module using these real owners. This tuple does not already contain a generation Artifact owner, selected artifact, generation FinalUse consumer, or target journal/witness. No public owner getter or synthetic grantor is justified.

findings.finding: The original Root issuer and the existing device/notes FinalUse consumers occupy different trust and process roles.
findings.evidence: Root production reception requires an actual non-Root consumer process different from the Root PID. It opens the original device/notes consumer nonce state under the exact owner UID/GID and canonical private paths, backed by the live Root frontier and issuer trust. The existing retained-Version issuer wrapper is destination-fixed to agentd.cell-generation.next-task-same-model and irreversibly attenuates to readback-only before its request.
findings.implication: Those device/notes consumers cannot simply be relabeled or reopened as a Root generation consumer. The retained-Version request is not an initial-publication grant path. Actual purpose-bound signed authorization and an original generation consumer with its current external frontier remain required.

findings.finding: Artifact and selected-generation construction require real independently authenticated material.
findings.evidence: LearningArtifactOwnerService::open takes original trust, signed writer lease, required current-head policy, withdrawal registry, storage binding and time; it recovers the actual registry and pending operations under the original writer fence. AgentdSelectedGenerationV1::load verifies the actual signed selection and original registry/payload files. AgentdGenerationUpdateAuthoritiesV1::new takes Arc<Mutex<LearningArtifactOwnerService>>, Arc<FinalUseAuthority>, and the trusted clock, and rejects a FinalUse authority without the independent external frontier.
findings.implication: UID 0 or a DTO naming the correct digests does not supply these values. An actual trusted host must provision the existing trust/leases/withdrawal frontier/selection/files and original consumer; the audit does not assert those production materials have been delivered.

findings.finding: The protected Current and live revalidation chain is already concrete and cannot be replaced by a callback.
findings.evidence: Current::open consumes the actual RootAuthorityDirectory and scope to load the protected existing store. Initial preparation and original recovery bind actual operation/intent/target/journal and the real Artifact/FinalUse owners. Private LiveGenerationCurrent retains that concrete Current, same authority Arcs and selected payload. Live checks retain Artifact -> selected payload -> FinalUse lock order, with the protected Control current checked around live I/O.
findings.implication: The legitimate cold entry is the original existing Current/journal recovery. It is not fresh initialization, a new grant, a trusted-by-assertion current function, or proof that a real Root process cold restart has occurred.

findings.finding: Ready-to-task and Cell creation preserve the original same-Arc custody, including drain.
findings.evidence: ReadyAgentdGenerationInitialV1::into_circuit_feature_task consumes the original journal and Arc<LiveGenerationCurrent>. PublishedCircuitFeatureTaskV1 is a sealed Arc<PublishedTask>. open_cell uses that same live guard and retains the same task. drain_completed_task explicitly requires Arc::ptr_eq(task, cell.task), original Source readback before/after, actual committed Cell, durable drain and final current recheck.
findings.implication: Another reconstructed task with equal digests is not an acceptable substitute. An Arc/Mutex/journal ownership object is not transferred by a JSON descriptor or an SCM_RIGHTS file alone. The inspected APIs do not provide a cross-process original-Current/Cell custody service; that missing service must not be simulated by serializing pointers or an arbitrary callback.

findings.finding: The new coordinator closes a local Root unit but exposes the precise remaining process-location issue.
findings.evidence: The prepared coordinator checks real and effective UID 0 at construction/publication/recovery/installation/drain. into_q24_task consumes Ready, internally supplies the same published task to the original with_q24_circuit_task_profile, and retains the actual returned Cell/Source. OriginalRootCircuitTaskRuntimeV1 returns an AgentdConfig and concrete custody as local Rust objects, not a wire envelope.
findings.implication: Shipping assembly must decide where these concrete objects and the exact daemon config/writer remain owned. Keeping Root custody in a separate process while running the present direct Cell path in a non-Root daemon is not solved by the current local wrapper. Moving checks after credential drop, creating a parallel Cell, or using a replacement Current would break its guarantees.

findings.finding: A purpose-bound resident candidate service exists, but still needs the original ten role streams and trusted inputs.
findings.evidence: register/recover_host_resident_learning_v3 uses the original protected issuer/lease/root factory and purpose-bound profile or independent readback authorization. into_candidate_service consumes the registration, actual handoff, actual consumer pidfd/peer identity and typed Material/protocol/loaded baseline/verifier. Fresh/recovered mode comes from the actual registration, not wire metadata.
findings.implication: This is a concrete service assembly point, not evidence that normal CLI already creates it. The actual role providers, connected channels, purpose/nonce/pidfd and lifecycle remain required. Synthetic fixture owners cannot fill the production dependency list.

findings.finding: The existing normal generation descriptor loader is a different, narrower path.
findings.evidence: The CLI descriptor reconstructs a selected Joint worker, durable inference control, exclusive Cell generation journal and independent witness, then installs NeuronGenerationRuntimeBootstrapV2. Its typed result is the generation runtime handle/bootstrap, not a Ready initial publication, concrete Root Current authority, selected Artifact, generation FinalUse consumer, or PublishedCircuitFeatureTask.
findings.implication: Its existence must be preserved and acknowledged, but it cannot be counted as the new Root-custody/ordinary-task assembly.

findings.finding: No deployed or qualifying execution is established by this source review.
findings.evidence: The frozen twelve new boundary rows all have product_callers=[]; exact literal checks of main, Root CLI, production launcher/inputs and runtime found no new coordinator, Q24 profile assembly, stage-owner completion, candidate-service or resident-registration calls. This is a bounded static observation, not a replacement for the full collector.
findings.implication: Prepared mechanisms, different-agent reviews, exact byte recovery and a frozen source graph are not independent real task B or a real-utility result. No gate, compiler, H call, grant issuance, ref movement or source mutation occurred here.

next_engineering_boundary.existing_owner_only_work: Inside the trusted Root host, a narrowly typed assembly may consume the existing protected issuer/root/lease factory plus explicitly supplied real Artifact, selected generation, generation consumer and target journal/witness, then use the original prepare/recover and the non-Clone custody. The current APIs already express those dependencies; implementation must preserve their original validations.
next_engineering_boundary.first_decision_required: Specify the concrete owner and process for the actual published task, Cell, Source, live Current checks and retirement, together with the single original AgentdConfig writer. The current separate Root host plus credential-dropped daemon path has no existing transfer that preserves this direct same-Arc relation.
next_engineering_boundary.not_an_authorization: This report authorizes neither a new grant nor a fresh store nor a new transport. It does not recommend weakening UID, owner, scope, writer lock, purpose, pidfd, live-current or same-Arc checks.
external_actual_inputs: Original Root protected state and current lease/issuer policy
Original Artifact trust, writer lease, current signed head/withdrawal frontier and payload/registry files
Actually authorized initial FinalUse grant for the prepared full binding and an original consumer with its external frontier
Original selected-generation material, target journal and independent witness
Original task definition/source/fence/circuit/routes/loaded model and same-owner files
Actual ten role channels and independent real task material where the candidate service is used

limitations: Not a complete repository call-graph scan.
Full Git retrieval is distinct from manual semantic review coverage; semantic findings are scoped to the cited constructors, entry paths and custody methods.
No real Root cold-restart, cross-UID full chain, external independent B, compiler or gate result is asserted.
The earlier 5-second cleanup timeout remains an error/unknown terminal state; cancellation by Drop does not prove join.
